scope.question: Does the accessible Abu Ubayd source witness verify Qurtubi's reported specific sense مثعب الحوض (cistern outlet/spout)?
scope.limit: Bounded source collation only. It does not adjudicate historical authenticity or authorize translation/publication.

arabic.source_url_kind: legacy numeric source id, not URL

qurtubi_witness.exact_scope: وقيل : هو مثعب الحوض خاصة ; حكاه أبو عبيد .
qurtubi_witness.role: Qurtubi reports this specialized cistern-outlet gloss from Abu Ubayd.

comparator.work: Gharib al-Hadith text hosted by IslamWeb
comparator.locator: Hadith/item 6, section titled الأحاديث المسندة, displayed printed pages 127-129; lines 81-97
relevant_text: The section explains صنبور as a palm shoot/stump in explanations attributed to Abu Ubayda and al-Asma'i, then Abu Ubayd's interpretation of a solitary person without child or brother.
It attributes a poem to Aws ibn Hajar.
At line 97 it attributes to Abu Ubayd another sense: a tube in a water vessel made of iron or lead from which one drinks.
comparator.finding: This accessible witness supports that Abu Ubayd transmitted other صنبور senses, including a drinking tube; the inspected passage does not give Qurtubi's specific مثعب الحوض gloss. It neither disproves that gloss elsewhere nor verifies it.

attribution_decision.retain: Keep Qurtubi's explicit حكى أبو عبيد as a report attribution for the cistern gloss.
attribution_decision.do_not_promote: Do not label مثعب الحوض a verified direct Abu Ubayd wording based on this comparator; do not substitute the water-vessel tube definition for the cistern sense.
attribution_decision.route_boundary: This is a written-source comparison, not evidence for an oral transmission chain.
attribution_decision.next_evidence_needed: A source-specific Abu Ubayd passage or edition locator carrying the cistern-outlet gloss; otherwise preserve the direct locator as unresolved.
